code_freeze_implication: Source changes alter code_fingerprint. Existing green freeze cannot describe changed source; preserve old scope/calibrations and version the updated execution scope with bounded parity, recovery and resource evidence.

checked_paths: All planned classifier consumer keys must exist and be terminal before key-specific deletion.
Resumed/recovered successes and terminal failures revisit feature-cache reclamation.
Retryable failures remain pending and cannot cause premature deletion.
Admission pressure drains completed workers and renews the current task lease.
Memoized preparation is released after successful cache read.
Any-completed publication retains worker and pending-queue bounds.
Serial models receive independent arrays; spawned workers receive independent serialized inputs.
Optional reclamation locks or file errors do not reclassify committed model results.
limitations: Transient retryable task failures retain artifacts until resumed attempts terminate; many such failures can still consume the byte cap and require recovery.
Active or malformed external cache-reader lease state conservatively prevents deletion.
Updated source requires frozen identity and integrated parity/recovery/resource validation before launch approval.

findings.description: Per-feature cleanup was checked at last classifier submission while consumers were still running. Both 120-cell calibrations retained all twelve feature artifacts until final cleanup, creating a risk of full-grid capacity rejection. Terminal consumer completion must revisit key-specific lease-safe deletion.
Historical peak cache bytes were zero because peak sampling happened after cleanup, despite more than 2.3GB of artifacts immediately before final cleanup.
FIFO draining left only one worker active for most large calibration time. Any-completed draining can publish and replace finished work promptly under the same worker and queue bounds.

The audited baseline bounded cache hit reads the whole payload four times and hashes it three times. Compatible classifiers repeated prepared-tuple loading, float32 conversion and frame digests. Updated runner code now reuses a prepared group and precomputes numeric matrices and digests; integrated parity and resource evidence remain required.

scientific_use: execution diagnostics only; no corrected performance conclusion
simulation_definition: Read successful result rows in existing FIFO publication order. Assign fixed observed worker_elapsed_s durations to four workers with a bound of eight pending futures. Compare draining oldest submitted with draining earliest completed. No new models or benchmark cells ran.
simulation_limitations: Excludes coordinator feature preparation, cache I/O, serialization, durable publication and process startup.
Treats task durations as fixed; different overlap can change CPU and memory contention.
The ratios are opportunities to investigate, not forecasts or guaranteed speedups.
